about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm Isaac, a full stack developer focused on building complete web products: from clear, fast interfaces to APIs, business logic, and data persistence.
about.p2: My career started during university, which gave me over 4 years of hands-on experience solving technical problems, working with clients, and seeing projects through from start to finish. I aim to deliver robust, maintainable solutions that fit what the product actually needs.

list.title: Soulutions Platform
list.description: Full stack web platform to centralize environmental and community initiatives in Costa Rica. Includes fundraising, milestone tracking, business logic, and backend services. I led the project's technical recovery, rebuilding the architecture and core modules.

list.title: Landing Page | Tecno Air Cold
list.description: Landing page focused on conversion and digital positioning. Includes service presentation, testimonials, and a direct contact system. I prioritized the user experience to help capture clients on a tight deadline.

list.title: ERP System | Tecno Air Cold
list.description: Internal application to streamline operational management. Includes attendance tracking, payroll calculation, and a service module for scheduling visits and generating automated maintenance reports.

list.title: Booking System | King of Kings
list.description: End-to-end solution for barbershops with two synchronized platforms. Client portal with real-time booking, GraphQL API, and an admin panel for metrics and schedule management.

list.title: Eureka Ticket
list.description: Full stack platform for ticket sales and event management. Covers sales, ticket transfers, event backend, and on-site access control with scanning.

list.title: Conta Fast
list.description: Full stack modernization of a legacy electronic invoicing platform. Migrated the stack, strengthened the backend with Node.js and MySQL, implemented RBAC, and improved integration with the Ministry of Finance.
